items.text: Usage data indicates Anthropic’s flagship model trails cheaper alternatives among developers despite its stronger capabilities.
items.text_zh: 使用数据表明，尽管能力更强，Anthropic的旗舰模型在开发者中的采用率仍落后于更便宜的替代方案。

items.text: Harvey introduced Tenet, a Kimi K3-based model post-trained with Fireworks for long-horizon legal-agent tasks.
items.text_zh: Harvey推出Tenet，这是一款与Fireworks联合后训练、面向长流程法律智能体任务的Kimi K3衍生模型。

items.text: Google Cloud published guidance for giving LLM agents session state so they can preserve context and preferences across interactions.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud发布指南，介绍如何为大模型智能体加入会话状态，使其能在多次交互间保留上下文和偏好。

items.text: AWS open-sourced Dogwood to define and enforce safer, more predictable tool-calling rules for AI agents.
items.text_zh: 亚马逊云科技开源Dogwood，用于定义并执行更安全、更可预测的AI智能体工具调用规则。

items.text: A new organizational-design proposal argues deployed AI agents need explicit roles, reporting lines and escalation paths.
items.text_zh: 一项新的组织设计主张认为，投入使用的AI智能体需要明确的角色、汇报关系和升级路径。

items.text: Flock Safety’s chief executive called for compromise as opposition grows toward the company’s AI-assisted camera surveillance network.
items.text_zh: 面对外界对其AI辅助摄像头监控网络日益强烈的反对，Flock Safety首席执行官呼吁各方寻求妥协。

items.text: Databricks demonstrated Unity AI Gateway for centrally tracking model, coding-agent and MCP usage, costs and access policies.
items.text_zh: Databricks演示Unity AI Gateway，可集中追踪模型、编程智能体和MCP工具的用量、成本及访问策略。

items.text: TechCrunch reviewed the unsettled legal standards governing whether copyrighted books may be copied to train AI models.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch梳理了围绕复制受版权保护图书训练AI模型这一行为尚未明朗的法律标准。

items.text: Amazon DynamoDB added native capabilities for AI-oriented search, reducing the need to maintain a separate vector database.
items.text_zh: Amazon DynamoDB加入面向AI搜索的原生能力，可减少维护独立向量数据库的需求。

items.text: AI21 Labs trained a lower-cost verifier that it says matches frontier-verifier quality across agentic systems.
items.text_zh: AI21 Labs训练了一款成本更低的验证模型，并称其在智能体系统中的质量可媲美前沿验证模型。

items.text: An experimental AI company boss dismissed its first employee only after human supervisors reminded the agent of its own rules.
items.text_zh: 一家实验性公司的AI老板在被人类监督者提醒其自身规则后，才解雇了第一名员工。

items.text: Lovart added a branding workflow that turns an uploaded visual identity and prompt into complete commercial campaign materials.
items.text_zh: Lovart新增品牌营销工作流，可根据上传的视觉识别资料和提示词生成完整商业宣传素材。

items.text: A World Robot Conference exhibit staged an immersive café where robots and people collaboratively handled service tasks.
items.text_zh: 世界机器人大会的一处展台打造沉浸式咖啡店，让机器人与人类协作完成服务任务。

items.text: A survey profiled Hong Kong professors commercializing embodied-AI research through robotics startups and university-linked ventures.
items.text_zh: 一篇行业调查介绍了香港教授如何通过机器人初创企业和高校关联项目，将具身智能研究推向商业化。

items.text: Nio autonomous-driving chief Ren Shaoqing reportedly founded an embodied-intelligence startup that will receive strategic investment from Nio.
items.text_zh: 据报道，蔚来智能驾驶负责人任少卿已创立一家具身智能公司，蔚来将对其进行战略投资。

items.text: Netflix open-sourced an agent workflow designed to conduct causal reasoning rather than merely identify correlations in observational data.
items.text_zh: Netflix 开源了一套智能代理工作流，旨在从观察数据中进行因果推理，而不只是识别相关性。

items.text: Cerebras unveiled its CS-4 system, claiming twice the performance of its predecessor while retaining the same wafer-scale processor.
items.text_zh: Cerebras 发布 CS-4 系统，宣称在沿用同款晶圆级处理器的情况下，将性能提升至上一代的两倍。

items.text: Robert Martin said his experiment trusting AI-generated code revealed unresolved reliability problems despite substantial productivity gains.
items.text_zh: 罗伯特·马丁表示，完全信任 AI 生成代码的实验虽显著提高了效率，却也暴露出尚未解决的可靠性问题。

items.text: An investigation found AI chatbots frequently directed pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosing those sites’ ideological affiliations.
items.text_zh: 一项调查发现，AI 聊天机器人经常把孕期用户引向反堕胎网站，却未披露这些网站的意识形态背景。

items.text: Alibaba’s Wan 3.0 became available on Leonardo AI, extending the video model’s distribution to another mainstream creative platform.
items.text_zh: 阿里巴巴 Wan 3.0 已登陆 Leonardo AI，进一步将这款视频模型覆盖到主流创作平台。

items.text: Dreamina showcased Seedance 2.5 generating a surreal video whose character becomes trapped inside a CAPTCHA interface.
items.text_zh: 即梦展示了 Seedance 2.5 生成的超现实视频，片中角色被困在验证码界面之中。

items.text: MIT Technology Review examined evidence that children infer language rules more effectively than current AI systems, with the underlying reason still unresolved.
items.text_zh: 《麻省理工科技评论》梳理的证据显示，儿童推断语言规则的能力优于当前 AI 系统，但原因仍未厘清。

items.text: Alibaba DAMO Academy introduced a liver-cancer AI model reportedly capable of accurately identifying tumors as small as one centimeter.
items.text_zh: 阿里达摩院推出一款肝癌 AI 模型，据称能够精准识别小至一厘米的肿瘤。

items.text: Zhongcheng Hualong released its HL200 inference chip alongside a supernode architecture designed to scale into clusters containing thousands of accelerators.
items.text_zh: 中诚华隆发布 HL200 推理芯片及配套超节点架构，目标是扩展至包含数千张加速卡的集群。

items.text: Wan 3.0 launched with native 30-second video generation, synchronized audio, multimodal references and improved temporal consistency.
items.text_zh: Wan 3.0 正式上线，支持原生生成 30 秒视频、音画同步、多模态参考输入，并提升了时序一致性。

items.text: A WRC presentation outlined native omni-modal world models that progress from passively simulating environments toward supporting interactive worlds.
items.text_zh: 世界机器人大会的一场演讲介绍了原生全模态世界模型，以及其从被动模拟环境迈向支持交互世界的路径。

items.text: Together AI said GLM-5.3 completed over five times more DeepSWE work than Fable 5 under an identical $100 budget.
items.text_zh: Together AI 表示，在同样的 100 美元预算下，GLM-5.3 完成的 DeepSWE 工作量超过 Fable 5 的五倍。

items.text: Sam Altman warned that concentrating control of advanced AI among too few organizations could create serious societal risks.
items.text_zh: 萨姆·奥尔特曼警告称，先进 AI 的控制权若集中在极少数机构手中，可能带来严重的社会风险。
